question: During the financial year 2019-20, from which of the following country was the highest amounts of FDI (foreign direct investment) inflows received by India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Singapore**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Singapore emerged as the largest source of FDI (foreign direct investment) in India during the financial year 2019-20** with a $ 14.67 billion investment.
 
• Sectors that attracted maximum foreign inflows during 2019-20 include **services, computer software, and hardware, telecommunication**, etc.
 
• **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) is a major driver of economic growth** and an important source of non-debt finance for the economic development of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/794ceab09d61fb2a95a5bb5685bacf6394817a0adda33ae96b418b7d20c1f1e2.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)**:

 
 
• Foreign direct investments (FDI) are **investments made by one company into another located in another country**.
 
• For investors, **open markets are more active than closed markets** when it comes to FDI.
 
• FDIs might be **horizontal, vertical, or conglomerate**.
 
• Horizontal refers to developing the same type of business in a new country, whereas vertical refers to a connected but distinct business venture, and conglomerate refers to a separate company enterprise.
 
• An example of FDI is Apple's investment in China.
